scripts.dev: pnpm run dev:dependencies && concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names learner,admin,api,worker --prefix-colors cyan,magenta,green,yellow "pnpm --filter @ac/learner-web dev" "pnpm --filter @ac/admin-web dev" "uv run python -m ac_platform.http --reload --port 8000" "uv run python -m ac_platform.worker"
scripts.format: prettier --write apps packages/typescript package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github/workflows/application.yml && uv run ruff format packages/python tests
scripts.format:check: prettier --check apps packages/typescript package.json pnpm-workspace.yaml .github/workflows/application.yml && uv run ruff format --check packages/python tests
scripts.lint: pnpm -r --if-present lint && uv run ruff check packages/python tests
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --if-present typecheck && uv run mypy packages/python
scripts.validate: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
